algorithm: 1. Verify source/admission binding and current guards. Preflight selected native units/config/clocks while every visit still validates the original full prefix. Use existing packet/unit/output/reserve bounds; do not ignore malformed excluded data.

2. For every packet in every selected input unit, including eventual exclusions, run existing PacketClock and cross-unit AAC continuity checks. Write the existing complete video/audio disk tapes. Compute AAC partitions alongside this tape; no second retained tape or duration-sized Vec.

5. Fixed local streamcopy retains whole selected video and only the planned AAC ordinals. Candidate must have exactly supported video0/audio1; compare every video packet and every retained AAC packet while also verifying excluded tape partitions and physical EOF.

aacRetention.rule: Let [Vstart,Vend) be the exact native selected video interval. Retain AAC packet P=[pts,pts+duration) iff P.end>Vstart && P.start<Vend using checked i128 rational comparisons. Equal-end at Vstart and equal-start at Vend are excluded. Never use wall time, float epsilon, intended seek or rounded output time.
aacRetention.subset: Preserve current AAC-LC44100stereo/native codec and PacketClock restrictions: PTS=DTS, positive known durations, exact continuity. Nonzero SkipSamples/discard/reasons remain explicitly unsupported, not removed or treated as audible coverage. None versus present-zero side-data remains part of exact packet identity. This batch does not add priming/discard semantics.
aacRetention.plan: Native-only AacRetention stores input_count, first retained0-based ordinal, exclusive_end, video interval, retained FoldResult and optional leading/trailing FoldResult plus first/last times. Before->Retained->After is one nonempty contiguous run; reject re-entry, interior gap/overlap/reset or overflow. All packets belong to exactly one partition; counts/bytes sum to full input. Recompute partition digests during comparison rather than combining hashes.
aacRetention.coverage: First retained packet starts at/before Vstart, last ends at/after Vend, and AAC intervals remain contiguous. Prove each retained boundary overhang is strictly less than that packet's duration. Boundary packets are unchanged: this is packet-aligned output, not sample-exact trimming or proof of physical audibility. Nonintersecting seconds from a selected AAC unit must not remain in the candidate.
aacRetention.comparison: Keep the single full selected-input AAC tape. Drain/re-fold leading exclusions; pair each candidate packet with one retained record; reject missing/extra output; then drain/re-fold trailing exclusions and validate Reader physical EOF. Every partition count/bytes/digest and first/last time must match. Tape error/truncation is never EOF. Full source/tape guards surround the operation.
aacRetention.bounds: Existing20M packets bounds ordinals below u32 wrap and exact FFmpeg expression integers. Constant-size summaries only. Empty excluded partitions are None; retained cannot be empty. No public constructor/deserialization or caller-provided filter string.

fixedSelectedRemux.argvDelta: Add only -bsf:a:0 with argument noise=amount=0:drop=lt(n\,FIRST)+gte(n\,END).
